messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — GPU capacity exhausted in aws-eu-west-2. Autoscaler failed to provision new instances due to account GPU quota limit. Inference queue (service=inference-gpu) growing for 10m. Pager: @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: acknowledged, I'm on it. Which pools are impacted and what symptoms are customers seeing?

ben_infra: confirmed: g4dn pools saturated. Ran quota check:
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-ABC123 --region eu-west-2
QuotaName: G4dn GPU instances per Region, Value: 8, Used: 8
```
Request to increase quota already failed earlier (limit per-account). AWS support ticket opened (case 1234567890).

claire_sre: autoscaler logs show repeated scale-up attempts timing out with 403 quota errors from AWS:
```
2026-03-15T12:01:17Z ERROR scale_manager.go: request failed: InstanceLimitExceeded: You have requested more instances (4) than your current instance limit of 0 allows for the specified instance type.
```
We retried launch 6 times — backoff reached.

devin_product: customer impact? any SLA hits? do we need to page CSMs?

emma_support: seeing spike in 5xx for premium cohort. Telemetry: p95 latency for /v1/generate rose 4s -> 12s, error rate up ~2.3% over last 20m, several customer-reported failures (tickets #7892, #7901). Support triage is notifying affected accounts.

frank_ml: suggest immediate mitigation: 1) fail traffic to smaller quantized model variant (cpu/low-gpu) 2) reduce concurrency per worker 3) enable KV prefix cache to reduce token compute. Can push a degraded model config in 2-3m.

alice_oncall: do the degraded model rollback now (priority). Ben/claire, try region failover for non-sensitive traffic to us-west-2. If we can shed non-SLA traffic, we can keep premium lanes healthy.

ben_infra: starting traffic split change in router:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-router/api/route" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROUTER_TOKEN}" -d '{"from":"eu-west-2","to":"us-west-2","percent":30,"match":"non-sla"}'
```
router response: 202 accepted. Propagation ~20s.

ops-bot: Runbook step 3 triggered: open cloud support escalation. AWS case 1234567890 status=pending; estimated response 2-4 hours. Reminder: runbook checklist -> "evict best-effort jobs first".

claire_sre: evicting best-effort pods now and moving to spot fallback pool to free GPU slots for premium requests. Command: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=0 --selector=priority=best-effort` — doing controlled drain.

emma_support: posting customer advisory draft to #customer-commms: "We're experiencing elevated errors and latency in europe (eu-west-2) due to cloud GPU provisioning limits. We're actively mitigating and will provide updates every 30m."

devin_product: add note to advisory that premium traffic prioritized and degraded fidelity model used temporarily. Keep language measured.

frank_ml: deployed quantized-1.8 model variant to the fallback pool and flipped the traffic flag for premium=false. Quick perf check: p95 on fallback now ~3s, but quality check needed.

alice_oncall: status update: routed 35% non-sla to us-west-2, evicted BE jobs, deployed quantized fallback for lower tiers. Error rate for premium dropped to 0.6% (from 2.3%). Queue depth reduced from 98% -> 62% in 12m. Still need permanent resolution for quota.

ben_infra: trying a manual capacity burn: we have a spare Dedicated reserved pool in eu-west-2 (dedicated-42) with 2 nodes free; allocating those into inference-gpu but it will take ~7m to warm. Alloc request submitted.

ops-bot: Note: runbook item "open increases for GPU quota" — you must include account id, justification, and expected sustained utilization. Template pasted to thread.

claire_sre: AWS responded to case 1234567890: "We've increased request to review. ETA 180 minutes." Not immediate. We should plan for hours.

alice_oncall: plan: (A) keep degraded routing and quantized fallback for 2-4 hours; (B) open internal sales/CS motion for customers >$X impact; (C) postmortem after incident with runbook updates (pre-checks before deployments). Who picks follow-up?

devin_product: I'll coordinate comms and customer outreach for affected accounts.

emma_support: I'm compiling list of affected tickets + CS contacts and sending to @devin_product.

frank_ml: action item: add automated pre-deploy quota check to CI for region eu-* and warn when projected required GPUs > 80% of quota. I'll draft PR.

alice_oncall: handing off operational ownership to @claire_sre for the mitigation window (next 3 hours). I'll remain available for escalation. Please update this thread with any AWS case progress or when dedicated pool warms.

claire_sre: acknowledged — taking oncall. Current last check: queue depth 52%, premium error rate 0.4%, p95 3.8s. Continuing monitoring.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity remains P1. Next automated update in 15m or on manual status post.

alice_oncall: post-incident tasks captured: update autoscaler to detect quota-denied errors and trigger cross-region failover earlier; add quota slack alert if projected usage >75%; schedule runbook review.

claire_sre: will create follow-up ticket and link AWS case. Also schedule a short retro with infra + product tomorrow.

ops-bot: runbook note appended to incident: "Consider prewarming Dedicated pool for predictable traffic spikes; add policy for rapid purchase / approval path."

emma_support: final note — customers contacted, CS working on credits for affected customers as needed.

alice_oncall: thanks team — handing off thread. Keep channel updated. :white_check_mark:
